meta.title: LiTT - Legal AI Platform
meta.description: AI-powered legal document analysis and contract review platform.

intake.title: New playbook with questions
intake.intro: Answer what you know about this client; every question is optional. The model writes a draft and shows where each rule comes from.
intake.name: Playbook name (optional)
intake.noModel: No model is available. <link>Configure an API key</link> or enable a local model.
intake.question: Question {number}
intake.attachPrompt: Drag and drop .docx or .pdf files here, or click to choose saved files or upload them.
intake.attachMorePrompt: Drop more files here, or click to add more.
intake.tooManyAttachments: You can attach up to {max, plural, one {# document} other {# documents}}.
intake.tooLong: Your answers add up to more than {max, number} characters. Shorten them.
intake.noAnswers: You haven't answered any question. Every rule of the draft will be general practice suggested by the AI, marked as without backing.
intake.discardMessage: What you wrote and the files you attached will be lost.
intake.startedMessage: This can take a few minutes. We'll let you know when it's ready.
intake.readyMessage: {name} is a draft: review its rules and mark it as ready before using it.
intake.failedMessage: The draft couldn't be written. Please try again.

questions.q1: Who do you represent, and who is the usual counterparty?
questions.q2: The client's industry and size, and the regulation of its sector (financial, health, personal data, government…).
questions.q3: Type of document: lease, services, NDA, purchase, supply, employment…
questions.q4: Jurisdiction and governing law; whether it accepts arbitration, and where.
questions.q5: Risk appetite: conservative, balanced or flexible.
questions.q6: Red lines: what this client never accepts.
questions.q7: What it can give up in a negotiation.
questions.q8: The client's preferred clauses or wording; you can attach them.
questions.q9: Background: past disputes, the relationship with the counterparty, and what went wrong before.

intake.q8Help: You can attach up to {max, plural, one {# .docx or .pdf document} other {# .docx or .pdf documents}}.

draft.label: Draft
draft.banner: Draft: it can't be used in reviews until an editor marks it as ready.
draft.confirmMessage: {unbacked, plural, one {# rule has} other {# rules have}} no backing and {unverified, plural, one {# legal reference is} other {# legal references are}} not verified. Once ready, it can be used in reviews and it can't go back to draft.

model.label: Model
model.copied: Your copy of {name} is a draft. Review its rules and mark it as ready.

origin.answer: Origin: answer to {count, plural, one {question} other {questions}} {questions}
origin.aiGeneral: Origin: general practice suggested by the AI
